 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Just over six years ago, Kai Havertz made the move to England. At Chelsea and now Arsenal, the German forward has earned his world-class status.
 In the big clash against Liverpool FC, the 27-year-old put the Gunners ahead. With his 46th Premier League goal, Havertz has now overtaken İlkay Gündoğan as the highest-scoring German in England's top flight.
 You don't need to be a prophet to predict that there will be plenty more to come.
